turns.question: How many leads did every 100 euros of social ad spend get us in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no leads-per-100-euros metric; the closest is cost per lead, which for social ads over 1-30 September 2026 was 52.5 EUR per lead (I can't derive the inverse myself). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
